analysis.title: The Gold Standard: Spot Gold Comparable Tables - Precious Metals Producers and Royalties
key_insights: Compendium of valuation tables for gold and silver producers and royalty companies, priced at spot gold US$4,066/oz and spot silver US$51.91/oz as of Nov 6, 2026. RBC price deck for gold is $4,539 (2026), $4,960 (2027), $5,400 (2028), long-term $4,000.

At spot, the coverage total average P/NAV is 1.19x. Royalty companies average 1.84x, large producers 1.30x, intermediate producers 1.07x, growth producers 1.18x, emerging producers 0.42x and silver producers 1.99x.

At the RBC deck, the total average P/NAV is 1.26x. Royalty companies average 1.93x, large producers 1.27x, intermediate producers 0.96x, growth producers 1.10x, emerging producers 0.44x and silver producers 1.42x.

Royalty companies trade at a premium to producers on EV/EBITDA at spot for 2026E: 18.9x versus 6.5x for large producers and 5.5x for intermediate producers. Royalty FCF/EV yield for 2026E is 0.0% at spot versus 6.5% for large producers.
Large producers' 2027E FCF/EV yield at spot averages 5.9%. At the RBC deck, large producers average 8.8% for 2027E and 10.6% for 2028E.
Highest P/NAV at spot among covered names: Hecla 2.25x, Wheaton 2.21x, Franco-Nevada 2.15x, Lundin Gold 2.00x. Lowest among developers: Seabridge 0.18x, Osisko Development 0.29x, i-80 Gold 0.44x.

Barrick is the only large producer below 1.0x P/NAV at spot (0.92x). Intermediate and growth producers below 1.0x at spot include Alamos (0.96x), Artemis (0.80x), B2Gold-adjacent names, Eldorado (0.86x), OceanaGold (0.95x), Centerra (0.94x) and K92 (0.67x).

NAV sensitivity: at a gold price of $3,000/oz and silver $38.30, large producers average P/NAV rises to 2.37x. At $6,000 and $76.60 it falls to 0.73x. Large producers have the highest operating leverage to the gold price, with NAV sensitivity of about 18% per +10% in spot.
Royalty companies show low sensitivity to the gold price (about 2% EBITDA change for 2026E per +10% in spot). Wheaton, Endeavour and Sunshine Silver show no sensitivity in the tables.
Large producers' 2026E EBITDA moves about 3% per +10% change in spot gold, and 2027E about 15%, since more of 2026 is already sold or priced.
Share price performance over 5 days: coverage average +13.5%, royalty +14.5%, large producers +14.1%, intermediate +17.8%. 1M average is -2.6% and YTD +3.0%.
Silver producers lag: 1M average -10.1%, YTD -17.3%, average 42% below 52-week highs. Hecla is 57% below its high, Coeur 44% below, Pan American 41% below.
Kinross is 43% below its 52-week high and -21.0% YTD, the weakest of the large producers. Newmont is 11% below its high and +21.1% YTD.
Balance sheets: large producers are net cash overall (average current net debt/market cap -3%). Eldorado has the highest leverage at 17% net debt/market cap, with 1.4x current net debt/EBITDA.
Cost forecasts: 2026E fully loaded co-product costs average $3,137/oz for large producers, rising from $2,312/oz in 2025E. Average reported AISC for large producers is $1,847/oz in 2026E.

Production outlook: Agnico Eagle 3,310koz in 2026E, Newmont 5,304koz, Barrick 3,233koz, AngloGold 2,663koz, Gold Fields 2,386koz and Kinross 1,824koz. Intermediate producers show growth with Equinox 893koz in 2026E rising to 1,182koz in 2027E.
Estimates updated for AU, B, CDE, GFI, IAG, IAU and LUG. All ratings and price targets reiterated. AngloGold's NAV/sh rose 3% to $73.77 and 2026-28E average adjusted EBITDA rose 3% to $9,271m.
Coeur Mining 2027E AISC falls from $476 to $263 per oz and 2028E from $356 to $153 per oz at the RBC deck, a large cost revision. Coeur 2026E EPS goes from $0.99 to $0.86.

risk_factors: Gold-price sensitivity: at $3,000/oz and $38.30 silver, large producers' P/NAV average would be 2.37x, with NAV falling about 18% per -10% move in spot.
Developers carry negative free cash flow: Seabridge, Osisko Development and Perpetua show deeply negative 2026-28E FCF/EV yields, and Speculative risk ratings.
Cost inflation: large producers' fully loaded costs rise from $2,312/oz in 2025E to $3,137/oz in 2026E on average.
Eldorado Gold is the most levered of the producers, with net debt/market cap of 17% and a -9.7% 2026E FCF/EV yield at spot.
Barrick's Q3 results had not been released when the estimates were updated.
